tasks.label: 1. Install Root Dependencies
tasks.detail: Step 1: Install all project dependencies in root directory

tasks.label: 3. Kill Port 3000
tasks.command: $proc = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -ExpandProperty OwningProcess -Unique; if ($proc) { $proc | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; Write-Output 'Killed process on port 3000' } else { Write-Output 'No process found on port 3000' }; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1
tasks.detail: Step 3: Kill any process using port 3000

tasks.label: 4. Clean Docs node_modules
tasks.command: $target = Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}' 'docs\node_modules'; if (Test-Path $target) { $scratch = Join-Path (Split-Path '${workspaceFolder}' -Parent) '.r3l-trash'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $scratch | Out-Null; $dest = Join-Path $scratch ('node_modules-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')); Move-Item -LiteralPath $target -Destination $dest; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $dest -Recurse -Force; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $scratch -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output 'node_modules permanently deleted' } else { Write-Output 'node_modules does not exist' }
tasks.detail: Step 4: Permanently delete docs/node_modules by moving it out of the workspace first, so nothing is moved to the recycle bin

tasks.label: 5. Clean Docs Cache
tasks.command: $scratch = Join-Path (Split-Path '${workspaceFolder}' -Parent) '.r3l-trash'; foreach ($name in @('.docusaurus', 'build')) { $target = Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}' ('docs\' + $name); if (Test-Path $target) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $scratch | Out-Null; $dest = Join-Path $scratch ($name + '-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')); Move-Item -LiteralPath $target -Destination $dest; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $dest -Recurse -Force; Write-Output ($name + ' permanently deleted') } }; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $scratch -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
tasks.detail: Step 5: Permanently delete docs/.docusaurus and docs/build by moving them out of the workspace first, so nothing is moved to the recycle bin

tasks.label: 6. Install Docs Dependencies
tasks.detail: Step 6: Execute pnpm install in docs directory

tasks.label: 8. Sync CodeGraph Index
tasks.detail: Step 8: Sync CodeGraph index with latest code changes

tasks.label: Full Setup: Install + Build + Start Docs
tasks.detail: Complete workflow: Install dependencies -> Build project -> Kill port -> Clean docs -> Install docs deps -> Start Docusaurus dev server -> Sync CodeGraph index
